dct_description_sm: The Hunter-Clyde Watershed Group Water Quality Monitoring project is designed to gather water quality baseline data and seasonal trends within the watershed. Water quality is collected using YSI probes, HOBO in-stream depth loggers (collects data in 15-minute intervals) and a flow probe at 6 locations throughout the watershed, and an additional 13 YSI only sites.
dct_title_s: Hunter-Clyde Watershed Group Water Quality Monitoring Data
